{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Trump undermined access to contraception as president by decreasing access for millions through sabotaging the Title X family planning grant program and weakening the ACA's coverage mandate.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump's allies have published plans to further attack access to contraception through executive action, including by further undermining women's insurance coverage for birth control and reducing access to condoms and emergency contraception.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court's elimination of the protections of Roe has had devastating consequences for families who have suffered the heartbreak of infertility.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Tens of thousands of Americans start or grow their families each year with the help of in vitro fertilization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In vitro fertilization is enormously popular and enjoys the support of the vast majority of Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's overturning Roe opened the door to laws that rip away access to in vitro fertilization, as seen when Alabama families had treatments halted earlier this year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden responded to attacks on reproductive care by expanding in vitro fertilization access for service members, veterans, and federal employees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump has refused to commit to vetoing the Life at Conception Act, a national abortion ban that threatens in vitro fertilization access nationwide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's allies are openly attacking in vitro fertilization.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
